content_zh:
所以醒来，一切都好了吧？
李神医瞳孔蓦地一缩。
这个称呼……
“你是谁？”他抓了乔昭的手，喝问。
粗糙干瘦的手搭在手腕上，乔昭猛然清醒，垂眸盯着那只手一动不动。
这只手她是熟悉的，曾经手把手教她针灸推拿，曾经笑着刮她鼻子说她学得快。
他是乔昭的李爷爷，却不能是黎昭的。
“小丫头到底是谁？”李神医并不是脾气好的人，声音更冷了一分。
乔昭抬眸与他对视，因为发烧音色没了平时的轻柔，沙哑如低低刮过青草地的风：“我是京中黎修撰之女，您是谁？”
李神医明显不信：“小丫头刚刚喊我什么？”
这小丫头有古怪，刚刚分明喊他李爷爷，而这个称呼，只有一个丫头这样喊过。
乔昭露出疑惑的神色，一双漆黑明亮的眸子微眯，似在回忆：“我刚刚想说，咦……爷爷您是谁？”
她无辜笑了笑：“不过还没说完，您就打断我啦。”
李神医愣了愣。
李……爷爷？咦……爷爷……
原来是听错了。
他松开乔昭手腕，可不知为何，心中还是有几分怪异。
总觉得这机灵古怪的丫头和记忆里那个聪慧的丫头有些相似。
她的病也有趣，除去发热不谈，神魂竟不大安稳，仿佛人的精神和身体不能很好的融合，要剥离似的。
想到这两年一直醉心研究的东西，李神医脑海中闪过一个模模糊糊的念头，扬声道：“进来吧。”

脚步声响起，初春的风随着门开涌进来，让人头脑一清。
池灿目光直接落到乔昭那里，见她已经醒来，一直紧绷的唇角微不可察松懈几分，这才看向李神医。
李神医一改先前的乖僻，温和问道：“小姑娘是你什么人呐？”
池灿下意识后退半步。
总感觉面前站了一只大尾巴狼！还是上了年纪老奸巨猾那种。
“萍水相逢而已……”池灿飞快把自己撇清。
“萍水相逢啊——”李神医拉长了声音。
池灿摸不清他的用意，解释道：“小姑娘被拐了，凑巧被我们碰到，我们顺路送她回家。”
“原来是这样。”李神医松了一口气，笑眯眯道，“小姑娘病得不轻，不是一天两天能好的。不如这样，就让这小姑娘跟着我吧，我医好了她，送她回家就是。”
“她要回京城。”池灿也不明白自己怎么回的这么快。
“那就更好了。”李神医摸摸胡子，“我也是去京城，路上可以行慢点，方便医治这小丫头。”
池灿不说话了，沉默片刻道：“这要问问她自己的意思。”
这老头莫不是拐子吧，那丫头只是发热，哪里就病得不轻了？
李神医便回过头去，笑问：“丫头，我是天下数一数二的神医，要不要跟我走？”
乔昭毫不犹豫：“跟。”
她原先所图的是平平安安回到京城，而半路上遇到李神医，就算不提前缘，有一位神医送她回家比起三位年轻公子送她回家，她将来的处境绝对是不同的。
乔昭不傻，自然知道怎么选择。
池灿眉头一跳，冷着脸一字一顿道：“你可想好了。”
乔昭乖巧点头：“想好了。”
池灿气结，转身拂袖欲走，又忽然转过身来，问她：“就不怕再被拐了？”

李神医翻了个白眼道：“臭小子说什么呢？”
乔昭轻柔地笑：“不会的，他是神医。”
“人家说什么，你就信啊？”池灿恨铁不成钢。
死丫头面对他们时的机灵劲呢？
乔昭眨眨眼：“若不是真的大夫，池大哥这么聪慧绝顶、小心谨慎的人，怎么会让他替我看诊呢？”
池灿嘴角动了动。
说的可真他娘的……有道理！
池灿没了话说，看着小丫头又莫名气闷，摸了摸鼻子，转身便走。
跟进来的三人却不干了，其中一人忙道：“神医，这……不大方便吧？”
主子可是千叮万嘱，万万不能节外生枝，务必把李神医悄悄请回去的。
李神医眼一瞪：“有什么不方便的？你们若是觉得不方便就自己走人！这小姑娘生了重病，医者仁心，我能见死不救吗？”
三人同时默默牵了牵嘴角。
说的好像您多有仁心似的。
他们寻到这位神医可没少吃苦头，千求万求都不愿意随他们进京，最后没办法使出了杀手锏，用主子手里一株稀世灵草才让这位神仙松了口。

content_en:
So wake up and everything is fine, right?
Divine Doctor Li's pupils suddenly shrank.
This title...
"Who are you?" He grabbed Qiao Zhao's hand and asked.
A rough and thin hand was placed on the wrist. Qiao Zhao suddenly woke up and stared at the motionless hand with lowered eyes.
She was familiar with this hand. He once taught her acupuncture and massage step by step. He once scratched her nose with a smile and told her that she learned quickly.
He is Qiao Zhao's Grandpa Li, but he cannot be Li Zhao's.
"Who is that little girl?" Doctor Li was not a good-tempered person, and his voice became even colder.
Qiao Zhao raised her eyes and looked at him. Because of the fever, her voice was no longer as soft as usual, and was hoarse like the wind blowing through the green grass: "I am the daughter of Li Xiuzhan in Beijing. Who are you?"
Doctor Li obviously didn't believe it: "What did the little girl just call me?"
This little girl is weird. She just called him Grandpa Li, and only one girl has ever called him Grandpa Li.
Qiao Zhao showed a puzzled look, and narrowed his dark and bright eyes, as if recalling: "I just wanted to say, eh... Grandpa, who are you?"
She smiled innocently: "But you interrupted me before I finished speaking."
Divine Doctor Li was stunned.
Li...Grandpa? Hey...Grandpa...
It turns out I heard it wrong.
He let go of Qiao Zhao's wrist, but for some reason, he still felt a little weird in his heart.
I always feel that this clever and eccentric girl is somewhat similar to the smart girl in my memory.
Her illness is also interesting. Apart from the fever, her spirit is not very stable, as if the human spirit and body cannot be well integrated and are about to separate.
Thinking of what he had been studying so passionately for the past two years, a vague idea flashed through Divine Doctor Li's mind, and he raised his voice: "Come in."
The sound of footsteps sounded, and the early spring wind rushed in as the door opened, making people's minds clear.
Chi Can's eyes fell directly on Qiao Zhao. Seeing that she had woken up, the corners of her tight lips relaxed slightly, and then he looked at Doctor Li.
Divine Doctor Li changed his previous eccentricity and asked gently: "Who are you, little girl?"
Chi Can subconsciously took half a step back.
I always feel like there is a big-tailed wolf standing in front of me! Still old and cunning.
"It's just a chance meeting..." Chi Can quickly distanced himself.
"We met by chance -" Divine Doctor Li said in a long voice.
Chi Can couldn't figure out his intention and explained: "The little girl was abducted, and we happened to meet her. We took her home on the way."
"So that's it." Doctor Li breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile, "The little girl's illness is not serious. She can't be cured in a day or two. Why not, just let the little girl follow me. I'll cure her and send her home."
"She's going back to the capital." Chi Can didn't understand why she came back so quickly.
"That would be better." Divine Doctor Li stroked his beard, "I am also going to the capital. I can go slower on the road so that I can treat this little girl more easily."
Chi Can stopped talking and said after a moment of silence, "You have to ask her what she means."
Could this old man be a kidnapper? That girl just had a fever, so how could she be seriously ill?
Divine Doctor Li turned around and asked with a smile: "Girl, I am one of the best miracle doctors in the world. Do you want to follow me?"
Qiao Zhao said without hesitation: "Follow."
What she originally wanted was to return to the capital safely, but she met Divine Doctor Li on the way. Even if she didn't have a predestined relationship, her future situation would definitely be different if a miracle doctor sent her home than when three young men sent her home.
Qiao Zhao is not stupid, he naturally knows how to choose.
Chi Can's brows jumped and he said with a cold face: "You have thought about it."
Qiao Zhao nodded obediently: "Think about it."
Chi Can was furious, turned around and was about to leave, then suddenly turned around and asked her, "Aren't you afraid of being abducted again?"
Divine Doctor Li rolled his eyes and said, "What did you say, brat?"
Qiao Zhao smiled softly: "No, he is a miracle doctor."
"Do you believe what others say?" Chi Can hated the iron.Where is the dead girl's cleverness when facing them?
Qiao Zhao blinked: "If he wasn't a real doctor, how could Brother Chi, who is so smart and cautious, let him treat me?"
The corners of Chi Can's mouth moved.
What a damn thing you said...it makes sense!
Chi Can was speechless, looking at the little girl feeling inexplicably depressed, touched her nose, turned around and left.
The three people who followed us stopped, and one of them hurriedly said: "Miracle doctor, this... is not very convenient, right?"
The master had repeatedly warned him not to cause any problems and to invite Divine Doctor Li back quietly.
Divine Doctor Li glared: "What's the inconvenience? If you feel it's inconvenient, just leave by yourself! This little girl is seriously ill, and the doctor is kind-hearted. How can I ignore her and not save her?"
The three of them shook their lips silently at the same time.
It sounds like you are very kind-hearted.
They had gone through a lot of hardships to find this miracle doctor. They begged and begged but were unwilling to accompany them to the capital. In the end, they had no choice but to use their trump card. They used a rare spiritual grass in the master's hand to make the immortal relent.
